compiled_state.title: Create review-defenses.md contract (DefenseStore record shape)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## test-exempt
Justification: (1) no conditional logic — pure markdown documentation, (2) any test would be a change-detector test only, (3) documentation artifact with no executable behavior.

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- DD1: relation taxonomy and DefenseStore record shape are documented as canonical contracts (DefenseStore record shape portion)

## What
Create `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md` following the established contract document structure (see confidence-signal.md as reference pattern).

## Content Requirements
The contract must define the **DefenseStore record shape** with all fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `prior_finding_id` | string | yes | ID of the finding being defended (from reviewer-findings.json) |
| `cited_lines_fingerprint` | string | yes | SHA-256 of concatenation of `<path>:<line_number>:<whitespace-collapsed-line-content>` for each cited line. Whitespace-only changes preserve binding; semantic edits void it. |
| `defense_text` | string | yes | Defense explanation, max 4096 chars |
| `defender` | string | yes | Agent or human identifier that wrote the defense |
| `cycle_number` | integer | yes | Review cycle number when defense was recorded (1-indexed) |
| `timestamp` | string | yes | ISO 8601 timestamp when defense was written |
| `severity_history` | array | yes | Per-cycle severity records for SC1 telemetry. Each entry: `{cycle: int, severity: string, relation: string \| null}` |
| `arbiter_ruling` | object | no | Present only when an arbiter resolved this defense. Fields: `ruling` (SUSTAIN_AT_SEVERITY \| ACCEPT_DEFENSE \| DOWNGRADE_TO_<severity>), `summary` (1-2 sentence summary in GitHubPRDefenseStore; full text in TrackerDefenseStore), `arbiter_cycle` (integer) |
| `ticket_id` | string | yes | Ticket bound at time of defense write. Set to `UNBOUND` when no session ticket (invalid — causes write failure per ticket-binding integrity rule) |

Also document:
- **Two-backend split**: TrackerDefenseStore (writes to ticket comments for local /dso:review) vs GitHubPRDefenseStore (writes to PR comments for CI). Both serialize this same record shape; arbiter_ruling field differs: TrackerDefenseStore stores full text; GitHubPRDefenseStore stores 1-2 sentence summary with link.
- **cited_lines_fingerprint computation**: SHA-256 of concatenation of `<path>:<line_number>:<whitespace-collapsed-line-content>` per cited line. Computed by the orchestrator, not the reviewer.
- **Durable binding contract**: subsequent cycles must not re-raise a finding_id against the same fingerprint state. If cited lines change semantically, binding is released (NEW_INTRODUCED authority applies). Whitespace-only changes preserve binding.
- **Ticket-binding integrity rule**: review without a session-bound ticket fails with exit code 1 and stderr containing literal string `ticket-binding required`.
- **Multi-bound session tiebreak**: writes to most-recently-active story (or epic if no story); recency defined as last `ticket transition` or last `ticket comment` timestamp (whichever later); same-timestamp tiebreak by lexicographic ticket-ID.
- **load_for_region(region_files)**: returns records filtered to those with any cited_lines path intersecting region_files. No-op default returns all records unfiltered.

## Document Structure
Follow escalate-review-signal.md pattern:
- `# Contract: review-defenses`
- Metadata block (Signal Name, Status: accepted, Scope, Date)
- Purpose
- DefenseStore Interface (load, write, load_for_region)
- Record Shape (full field table with types, required, descriptions)
- Two-Backend Split (TrackerDefenseStore vs GitHubPRDefenseStore differences)
- cited_lines_fingerprint Computation
- Durable Binding Contract
- Ticket-Binding Integrity
- Multi-Bound Session Tiebreak
- Example Payload
- Failure Contract (ticket-binding failure, write failures, fork-PR no-op)
- Consumers table
- Versioning / Change Log

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Contract file exists at expected path
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md
- [ ] Contract defines cited_lines_fingerprint field
  Verify: grep -q "cited_lines_fingerprint" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md
- [ ] Contract defines severity_history field
  Verify: grep -q "severity_history" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md
- [ ] Contract defines ticket-binding integrity rule
  Verify: grep -q "ticket-binding required" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md
- [ ] Contract defines two-backend split (TrackerDefenseStore and GitHubPRDefenseStore)
  Verify: grep -q "TrackerDefenseStore" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md && grep -q "GitHubPRDefenseStore" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md
- [ ] Contract follows established structure (has Purpose and Signal Name sections)
  Verify: grep -q "## Purpose" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md && grep -q "Signal Name" plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment: 1) cited_lines_fingerprint algorithm must be explicitly specified: SHA-256 of LF-normalized, trailing-whitespace-stripped concatenation of '<path>:<line_number>:<content>' per cited line, encoded as UTF-8 bytes, output as lowercase hex. Add: Verify: grep -q 'SHA-256\|sha256\|sha_256' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md && grep -q 'UTF-8\|utf-8\|unicode\|codepoint' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md. 2) defense_text 4096-char cap: contract MUST specify unit (Unicode codepoints) and over-cap behavior (reject with error vs truncate-with-truncation-marker). Add: Verify: grep -q 'codepoint\|Unicode\|4096' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md.
